description: PowerBI slicer navigation failed during automated pipeline data extraction. JavaScript-based DOM interaction (click, mousedown, mouseup, dispatchEvent) did not trigger filter changes on the co-sell pipeline page.

context.phase: Phase 2b - Click Each Location Filter (Dallas, TX)
context.symptom: Pipeline Revenue and Pipeline Opps KPIs remained '(Blank)' after filter interaction attempts

root_cause: PowerBI uses shadow DOM or iframe isolation that prevents JavaScript DOM manipulation from triggering filter state changes. Slicer elements are present in DOM but do not respond to synthetic click events.
impact: Cannot extract disaggregated pipeline data for Dallas, Houston, Austin. Cannot calculate Rock 4 gap. Scheduled task cannot complete.
mitigation_tried: DOM-based element discovery with className inspection
next_steps: Escalate to Improving IS/automation team for PowerBI connector support
Consider manual daily dashboard review as temporary workaround
Evaluate PowerBI REST API or native PowerBI Python/R libraries as alternative
